summary: Frontend-only iteration 5 testing for Swift Formations advisor avatar + mobile header advisor button. All 7 review checks (across desktop 1920x1080 and mobile 390x844) pass. Avatar loads correctly from images.unsplash.com on header pill, mobile header button, dialog header (h-12 w-12), and mobile menu tile. md:hidden / hidden md:flex CSS gating works correctly. Mobile booking flow end-to-end works (POST /api/leads/advisor-booking returns success and shows advisor-success view).
critical_code_review_comments: Minor: AdvisorDialog.js DialogContent has BOTH overflow-hidden and overflow-y-auto Tailwind classes (line 115). overflow-y-auto wins, so scrolling works, but the redundant overflow-hidden is dead/conflicting CSS and should be removed.
Minor: AdvisorDialog imports CalendarCheck2 from lucide-react but is still used inside the submit button (line 239) — fine, no unused import. No issues.
Minor: Header.js mobile-header-advisor-button uses ml-auto which works because nav is hidden lg:flex and desktop cluster is hidden md:flex; layout verified visually correct. No fix needed.
